<text x='0' y='30' font-size='24' font-weight='bold' fill='%230E0E0C'>I tagged every figure in the ledgers with where it came from.
<text x='0' y='70' font-size='22' fill='%230E0E0C'>ACTUAL is what Deere, FRED or Nasdaq reported. GUIDANCE is what management expects. MODEL is what I assumed.
